app_tagline: Friendly bets for friends and family. Pick a slot, closest guess takes the pot.
home_groups_empty: You're not in any groups yet. Create one and invite your friends or family, or open an invite link someone sent you.
form_display_name_hint: This is what others in your groups see, e.g. your first name.
signup_check_email: Almost there! We've sent a confirmation link to {email}. Open it to finish signing up.
error_display_name_length: Your display name can be at most {max} characters.
error_password_short: Your password must be at least {min} characters.
error_email_not_confirmed: Please confirm your email first. Check your inbox and spam folder for the link.
error_confirm_failed: That confirmation link didn't work. It may have expired, so try logging in or sign up again.
error_generic: Something went wrong. Please try again.
group_private_hint: Only people with the invite link can join.
group_public_hint: Anyone with an account can find and join it.
group_members_can_create_bets_hint: If this is off, only you and admins can create bets.
group_error_name_missing: Please give the group a name.
group_error_name_long: The name can be at most {max} characters.
group_error_description_long: The description can be at most {max} characters.
group_public_join_intro: This is a public group. Join it to see the bets and place your own.
bets_coming_soon: No bets yet. Creating bets is coming next.
invite_hint_private: Send this link to the people you want in the group. Anyone with it can join.
invite_hint_public: Share this link to bring people straight to the group.
invite_regenerate_hint: If the link ended up somewhere it shouldn't, make a new one. The old link stops working, but nobody is removed from the group.
invite_regenerate_confirm: Make a new invite link? The current one will stop working.
invite_regenerated: New link made. Find it on the group page.
nickname_hint: Leave it empty to use your account name ({name}).
leave_confirm: Leave {group}? You'll need a new invite to rejoin.
join_invalid: This invite link isn't valid. It may have been replaced with a new one, so ask for a fresh link.
join_not_allowed: You can't join this group without an invite link.
delete_group_hint: Deletes the group with all its bets and points. This can't be undone.
delete_group_confirm: Delete {group} with all its bets and points? This can't be undone.
login_to_join: You've been invited to a group. Log in, or sign up if you're new, and you'll be taken straight back to the invite.
